description: This Java class 'webDB' manages database connections and executes SQL queries for the online grocery ordering system. It provides static methods to create a connection, execute search queries, execute insert/update/delete operations, and retrieve the connection object.

classes.name: webDB
classes.description: A utility class for managing MySQL database connections and executing SQL queries within the 'freshco.Model' package.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Initializes the database connection if it has not been established, loading the MySQL JDBC driver and connecting to the database at 'jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/freshco' with username 'root' and password 'Jingles@1'.

methods.name: executeSearch
methods.description: Executes a SQL SELECT query passed as a string argument and returns the ResultSet. Ensures the database connection is established before executing.

methods.name: executeIUD
methods.description: Executes an INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE SQL query passed as a string argument and returns the number of affected rows. Ensures the connection is established first.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current Connection object, establishing a new connection if the existing one is null or closed.
